children: Retail sales dropped 2.3% year-on-year, against expectations for a 1.1% decline, after a 0.4% fall in August. Analysts had expected a 0.4% increase for the month.

On a monthly basis, retail sales fell 2.0%, reversing the previous month's increase and marking a significantly weaker outcome than economists had anticipated. The data suggest German households remain cautious despite easing inflationary pressures and improving wage growth.
Reporting by Frank Prenesti for Sharecast.com
